mapper.sql: WITH per_minute AS ( SELECT viewer_id, date_trunc('minute', sent_at) AS minute, LEAST(count(*), 3) AS capped_chats, COALESCE(SUM(log(amount + 1)) FILTER (WHERE message_type = 'DONATION' AND amount > 0), 0) AS donation_log FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY viewer_id, date_trunc('minute', sent_at) ) SELECT pm.viewer_id, SUM(pm.capped_chats)::int AS chat_score, COUNT(*)::int AS watch_score, ROUND(SUM(pm.capped_chats) + COUNT(*) * 2 + SUM(pm.donation_log) * 10, 2) AS total_score FROM per_minute pm GROUP BY pm.viewer_id
mapper.select:
SELECT agg.viewer_id, vp.nickname, vp.viewer_hash, agg.chat_score, agg.watch_score, agg.total_score FROM (
) agg JOIN viewer_profiles vp ON vp.id = agg.viewer_id WHERE COALESCE(vp.user_role, '') NOT IN ('streamer', 'manager', 'streaming_chat_manager', 'streaming_channel_manager') ORDER BY agg.total_score DESC, agg.viewer_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO viewer_scores (streamer_id, viewer_id, session_id, chat_score, watch_score, total_score) SELECT bs.streamer_id, agg.viewer_id, #{sessionId}, agg.chat_score, agg.watch_score, agg.total_score FROM (
) agg JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = #{sessionId} ON CONFLICT (session_id, viewer_id) DO UPDATE SET chat_score = EXCLUDED.chat_score, watch_score = EXCLUDED.watch_score, total_score = EXCLUDED.total_score
